name: Magnifying power of a compound microscope
description: The magnifying power (MP) of a compound microscope is the product of the magnification of the objective and the magnifying power of the eyepiece.

name: Magnifying power of astronomical telescope
description: The magnifying power (MP) of the refracting astronomical telescope is defined as the ratio of the angle β subtended by the image seen by the eye through the optical instrument to the angle α subtended by the object as seen without instrument.

name: Luminous intensity
description: Luminous intensity I_v is a measure of the luminous flux emitted by a light source in a direction per unit solid angle.

name: Illuminance
description: Illuminance E_v is the total luminous flux incident on a surface per unit area.

name: The Inverse Square Law of Illuminance
description: The illuminance E_v on a surface of distance r away from the source of light of luminous intensity I_v.
